name: VGI-bench
description: VGI-bench evaluates models' abilities to ground language in visual inputs and perform visually grounded interactions or reasoning. It contains multimodal examples requiring models to interpret images, answer questions, and follow multi-step visual instructions. The benchmark is suitable for assessing visual understanding combined with instruction following or dialog.
reputation: An emerging multimodal benchmark from ONE-Lab with growing interest for evaluating visual grounding and interactive capabilities.
